title: Bridge a seam between brick courses
applicability: Use on a wall or plate assembly with contiguous studded surfaces at a shared height. A spanning element needs mated underside sockets over both sides of the seam.
aliases: interleave bricks to stop a split
steps: Lay neighboring courses at the same bearing height. Move the joint in the next course so its underside actually meets a stud from each section.

To bond two lower 3004 bricks touching at x=2, place a third 3004 one brick higher starting at x=1. At a corner, alternate which leg runs through the corner or use a corner plate with sockets on both legs.
Check both support and the number of connected components. As a check on the bond, remove the bridge and verify that the two lower bricks become separate components.
expected: The three-brick assembly is valid and connected. With the bridging brick removed, both lower bricks stay on the ground and form two connected components.
